signal: Rilla hit $70M in ARR in April 2026, up from $51M in 2025, and launched Rilla Intelligence to move from individual rep coaching to company-level analytics.

email.body1:
Lisha, saw Rilla hit $70M in ARR this spring, up from $51M, and launched Rilla Intelligence for company-level analytics.

Growth that fast usually means more home-services and field-sales accounts in play than BD can touch before they cool off. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Rilla off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lisha, quick follow-up for Rilla.

At this growth rate, expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need for the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Rilla needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Lisha, last bit of proof for Rilla.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other high-growth sales-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lisha, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding BD headcount is not a priority while you ride this growth, no problem at all. A steep growth curve is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a field-sales-tech motion? I will tailor it to Rilla either way.
